name: risk-control-modeling
description: Interactive end-to-end credit risk modeling expert: data exploration, feature engineering (IV/PSI/WOE), tree-model development & tuning (XGBoost/LightGBM), evaluation (AUC/KS/PSI), and scorecards on demand — with key decisions confirmed by the user, extensible via MCP connectors & skills.
